Name: Charizard - Flying Mount and Roost (EN ES ZH)
Author: POCHIMODS
Description:
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54590/54590-1792961706-515987015.gif[/img]
[i]Nighttime glow · Luz nocturna · 夜间照明[/i][/center]

[center][size=3][color=#6CA9A5]━━━━━━[/color] [color=#D7A064]◇[/color] [color=#F1CB85]◆[/color] [color=#D7A064]◇[/color] [color=#6CA9A5]━━━━━━[/color][/size]
[size=3][b]ENGLISH[/b][/size]
[color=#F1C778][size=5][b]Charizard — Flying Mount & Roost[/b][/size][/color]
[size=3][color=#6CA9A5]━━━━━━[/color] [color=#D7A064]◇[/color] [color=#F1CB85]◆[/color] [color=#D7A064]◇[/color] [color=#6CA9A5]━━━━━━[/color][/size][/center]

Explore the valley on your very own Charizard! Its animated wings, custom roost and nighttime light bring a little Pokémon magic to your farm.

[center][size=2][color=#659D99]──────────[/color] [color=#DDB378]◇[/color] [color=#659D99]──────────[/color][/size][/center]

[color=#8BC9C4][size=3][b]Features[/b][/size][/color]
• An independent mount: you can keep Charizard and your normal horse at the same time.
• Four directions, animated wings and wing sounds that play when the wings are down.
• Charizard glows in the dark and illuminates the area around it when night falls.
• Its own Charizard-inspired roost, with a teal roof and wooden details.
• The same movement speed and collisions as the horse.

[center][size=2][color=#659D99]──────────[/color] [color=#DDB378]◇[/color] [color=#659D99]──────────[/color][/size][/center]

[color=#8BC9C4][size=3][b]Where to get Charizard[/b][/size][/color]
Visit Robin’s Carpenter’s Shop and choose [b]Charizard Roost[/b] in the farm-building menu.
[b]Cost:[/b] 20,000g + 100 Hardwood + 5 Iron Bars. Construction takes 2 days and uses a 4 × 2 tile footprint.
The roost includes its own Charizard. Interact to mount or dismount. Charizard returns to its roost each morning.

[center][size=2][color=#659D99]──────────[/color] [color=#DDB378]◇[/color] [color=#659D99]──────────[/color][/size][/center]

[color=#8BC9C4][size=3][b]Installation[/b][/size][/color]
Requires Stardew Valley 1.6 for PC and SMAPI 4.x.
1. Install SMAPI from [url=https://smapi.io]https://smapi.io[/url] if you do not already have it.
2. Download the mod and extract the [b]CharizardMount[/b] folder into your game’s [b]Mods[/b] folder.
3. Check that the path is [b]Mods/CharizardMount/manifest.json[/b], without an extra nested folder.
4. Launch the game through SMAPI and visit Robin to build the roost.
No Content Patcher or Fashion Sense is required.

[center][size=2][color=#659D99]──────────[/color] [color=#DDB378]◇[/color] [color=#659D99]──────────[/color][/size][/center]

[color=#8BC9C4][size=3][b]Languages & settings[/b][/size][/color]
Includes English, Spanish and Simplified Chinese.
You can adjust the light, wing sounds and flight in [b]config.json[/b]. Close the game before editing it.


[center][size=3][color=#6CA9A5]━━━━━━[/color] [color=#D7A064]◇[/color] [color=#F1CB85]◆[/color] [color=#D7A064]◇[/color] [color=#6CA9A5]━━━━━━[/color][/size]
[size=3][b]ESPAÑOL[/b][/size]
[color=#F1C778][size=5][b]Charizard — Montura voladora y refugio[/b][/size][/color]
[size=3][color=#6CA9A5]━━━━━━[/color] [color=#D7A064]◇[/color] [color=#F1CB85]◆[/color] [color=#D7A064]◇[/color] [color=#6CA9A5]━━━━━━[/color][/size][/center]

¡Recorre el valle sobre tu propio Charizard! Sus alas animadas, su refugio personalizado y su luz nocturna añaden un toque Pokémon a tu granja.

[center][size=2][color=#659D99]──────────[/color] [color=#DDB378]◇[/color] [color=#659D99]──────────[/color][/size][/center]

[color=#8BC9C4][size=3][b]Características[/b][/size][/color]
• Una montura independiente: puedes tener a Charizard y a tu caballo normal a la vez.
• Cuatro direcciones, alas animadas y sonido de aleteo cuando las alas están abajo.
• Charizard brilla en la oscuridad e ilumina la zona a su alrededor cuando anochece.
• Refugio propio inspirado en Charizard, con tejado azul verdoso y detalles de madera.
• La misma velocidad y las mismas colisiones que el caballo.

[center][size=2][color=#659D99]──────────[/color] [color=#DDB378]◇[/color] [color=#659D99]──────────[/color][/size][/center]

[color=#8BC9C4][size=3][b]Dónde conseguir a Charizard[/b][/size][/color]
Ve a la carpintería de Robin y elige [b]Refugio de Charizard[/b] en el menú de construcción de edificios de granja.
[b]Precio:[/b] 20.000 g + 100 maderas nobles + 5 lingotes de hierro. Tarda 2 días y ocupa 4 × 2 casillas.
El refugio incluye su propio Charizard. Interactúa para montar y desmontar. Charizard vuelve a su refugio cada mañana.

[center][size=2][color=#659D99]──────────[/color] [color=#DDB378]◇[/color] [color=#659D99]──────────[/color][/size][/center]

[color=#8BC9C4][size=3][b]Instalación[/b][/size][/color]
Requiere Stardew Valley 1.6 para PC y SMAPI 4.x.
1. Instala SMAPI desde [url=https://smapi.io]https://smapi.io[/url] si todavía no lo tienes.
2. Descarga el mod y extrae la carpeta [b]CharizardMount[/b] en la carpeta [b]Mods[/b] del juego.
3. Comprueba que quede [b]Mods/CharizardMount/manifest.json[/b], sin otra carpeta intermedia.
4. Inicia el juego con SMAPI y visita a Robin para construir el refugio.
No necesita Content Patcher ni Fashion Sense.

[center][size=2][color=#659D99]──────────[/color] [color=#DDB378]◇[/color] [color=#659D99]──────────[/color][/size][/center]

[color=#8BC9C4][size=3][b]Idiomas y ajustes[/b][/size][/color]
Incluye inglés, español y chino simplificado.
Puedes ajustar la luz, el sonido de las alas y el vuelo en [b]config.json[/b]. Cierra el juego antes de editarlo.


[center][size=3][color=#6CA9A5]━━━━━━[/color] [color=#D7A064]◇[/color] [color=#F1CB85]◆[/color] [color=#D7A064]◇[/color] [color=#6CA9A5]━━━━━━[/color][/size]
[size=3][b]简体中文[/b][/size]
[color=#F1C778][size=5][b]喷火龙 — 飞行坐骑与专属小屋[/b][/size][/color]
[size=3][color=#6CA9A5]━━━━━━[/color] [color=#D7A064]◇[/color] [color=#F1CB85]◆[/color] [color=#D7A064]◇[/color] [color=#6CA9A5]━━━━━━[/color][/size][/center]

骑上你自己的喷火龙，探索星露谷！动态翅膀、专属小屋与夜间照明，为你的农场增添一份宝可梦的乐趣。

[center][size=2][color=#659D99]──────────[/color] [color=#DDB378]◇[/color] [color=#659D99]──────────[/color][/size][/center]

[color=#8BC9C4][size=3][b]特色[/b][/size][/color]
• 独立坐骑：可以同时拥有喷火龙和原本的马。
• 四个方向的外观、拍翅动画，以及翅膀向下时播放的音效。
• 喷火龙会在黑暗中发光，天黑后照亮周围的区域。
• 喷火龙主题的专属小屋，采用青绿色屋顶与木质细节。
• 移动速度和碰撞规则与原版马相同。

[center][size=2][color=#659D99]──────────[/color] [color=#DDB378]◇[/color] [color=#659D99]──────────[/color][/size][/center]

[color=#8BC9C4][size=3][b]如何获得喷火龙[/b][/size][/color]
前往罗宾的木匠商店，在农场建筑菜单中选择[b]“喷火龙小屋”[/b]。
[b]价格：[/b]20,000 金 + 100 个硬木 + 5 个铁锭。建造需要 2 天，占地 4 × 2 格。
小屋自带一只喷火龙。与它互动即可骑乘或下坐骑。每天早晨，喷火龙都会回到自己的小屋。

[center][size=2][color=#659D99]──────────[/color] [color=#DDB378]◇[/color] [color=#659D99]──────────[/color][/size][/center]

[color=#8BC9C4][size=3][b]安装方法[/b][/size][/color]
需要电脑版《星露谷物语》1.6 和 SMAPI 4.x。
1. 如果尚未安装 SMAPI，请先从 [url=https://smapi.io]https://smapi.io[/url] 安装。
2. 下载本模组，将 [b]CharizardMount[/b] 文件夹解压到游戏的 [b]Mods[/b] 文件夹。
3. 确认路径为 [b]Mods/CharizardMount/manifest.json[/b]，中间不要多套一层文件夹。
4. 通过 SMAPI 启动游戏，再到罗宾处建造小屋。
不需要 Content Patcher 或 Fashion Sense。

[center][size=2][color=#659D99]──────────[/color] [color=#DDB378]◇[/color] [color=#659D99]──────────[/color][/size][/center]

[color=#8BC9C4][size=3][b]语言与设置[/b][/size][/color]
内含英语、西班牙语和简体中文。
可在 [b]config.json[/b] 中调整照明、拍翅音效和飞行。修改前请先关闭游戏。
